newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl congratulates France's Jospin, thanks Juppe.
newsitem.headline: Kohl congratulates France's Jospin, thanks Juppe.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl on Monday congratulated new French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin after his Socialist party's election victory and said he was sure the two countries would continue to work closely together.

"You are taking up your high and responsible office in a phase of decisive direction-taking for the future of Europe," Kohl wrote in a telegram to Jospin. "Peace, freedom, well-being and social stability must be secured for the next generation.
"I am sure that also under your leadership Germany and France will work together closely and full of trust in reliable partnership in the building of the joint house of Europe."

The conservative German chancellor also sent a telegram to outgoing Prime Minister Alain Juppe, thanking him for his work in further deepening the process of European integration and strengthening Franco-German relations.
